t: This is the London Central Mosque, a place of worship on the edge of Regent's Park, in the City of Westminster. It was designed by Sir Frederick Gibberd, an English architect, town planner and landscape designer. Gibberd is best known for Liverpool Metropolitan Cathedral, and for his work in Harlow, in Essex. He also gave his name to the widely used BISF house. Here, on the park's edge, you're seeing the work of a man who shaped whole towns as well as individual buildings.
